title: Review of c04's clipped-penalty crawler sweep: the boom-bust and the weak 2-3-crawler regime replicate on seed 2 (Supported)
summary: Fresh seed 2, labkit runs of 20261025T0908-c04-crawler-divide-confound/world.py with WORLD_P bV=1, okclip=1 and shed = 0.1 or 0.2 (T=600, 240 frames). shed 0.1: the planted crawler grows into long crawling strands that break into up to 13 bodies by t~260, the food is used up, the bodies round off, stop and starve, and 1 remains at t=600 (22 splits, 1 persistent, max generation 1). shed 0.2: 2-3 crawlers that travel up to 8.6 body lengths, 4 splits, 2 persistent, max generation 2. As the finding says, removing the content-independent growth drive leaves either a boom then starvation, or a few crawlers without generation >= 3.

observations.M: rerun_shed0.2/seed2/FACTS.md: crawlers move up to 8.6 body lengths

seeds_run.result: pass: shed 0.1 boom (13) then starvation to 1; shed 0.2 max generation 2

verdicts.limitation: Two of the seven sweep points on one fresh seed; I did not rerun the kup/rn arms. The founder is planted, so generation counts start from a single seeded crawler.
